QuestInfo.name: The Three Sisters
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta sought out three sisters that were after #p2420015#, but would they share their information. #b#p2420012##k seemed to be the ringleader, so they talked to her first...
QuestInfo.1: The three sisters claimed that #p2420015# stole something from them, and they had been chasing him ever since. The duo saw an opportunity, but though the sisters were looking for allies, they would need to prove their worth once again. The sisters required them to bring back a #bkey#k from the #r#o9300760##k in #b#MDmirrorD_322_1_##k.
QuestInfo.2: With the key returned, Alpha and Beta went to #p2420012# to find out where Phantom was hiding.

0.0: Eh, hehehe, sorry! I always get excited when I think about vengeance. That jerk Phantom stole my family's entire fortune. That's why the three of us are working here!
0.1: But we're not exactly the fightingest gals in the world, ya know? We've just been gathering as much information as we could, just in case we met somebody like you two that could beat him up for us!
0.2: But, I mean, I can't just GIVE this stuff away to ANYBODY. Right? You know what I'm talking about. I need to see how tough you two are!
